excerpt: While the old layout had inter-telescope distances ranging from 35 m to 127 m, the new layout distances range from 81 m to 127 m. Figure 1 labels the new-layout spacings 81m, 102m, 99m, 127m and the T2-T3 diagonal 111m.
publisher: J. S. Perkins, G. Maier for the VERITAS Collaboration (2009 Fermi Symposium, eConf C091122)
title: VERITAS Telescope 1 Relocation: Details and Improvements
